name: Ararat Brandy Factory Masterclass
description: Step into the historic cellars of the Yerevan Brandy Company to uncover the secrets of Armenian 'cognac'. You will tour the aging warehouses, learn about the local grape varieties, and enjoy a guided tasting of aged blends paired with traditional Armenian dried fruits and chocolate.
duration_note: Advance booking recommended.

name: Tsitsernakaberd Memorial Reflection
description: Walk the solemn path to the Armenian Genocide Memorial complex overlooking the Hrazdan Gorge. You will pay respects at the eternal flame and explore the underground museum, gaining a deep, necessary understanding of Armenian history and resilience.
duration_note: A place of profound significance; dress modestly and observe silence.

name: Gata & Coffee Morning at Tumanyan Street
description: Start your day like a local by grabbing a warm, flaky 'gata' pastry from a traditional bakery on Tumanyan Street. You will pair this buttery, sweet delight with a strong, unfiltered Armenian coffee served in a classic copper cezve.

name: Craft Cocktails at Simona Bar
description: Dive into Yerevan’s modern bar scene at Simona, a hip, compact spot known for its energetic vibe and expert mixologists. You will sip on experimental cocktails while rubbing shoulders with the city’s creative youth and listening to curated vinyl sets.
duration_note: Crowded on weekends; show up early to secure a stool.

name: Khor Virap Monastery Sunset View
description: Visit this iconic monastery complex located just meters from the border with Turkey. You will descend into the deep, narrow dungeon where St. Gregory the Illuminator was imprisoned, then climb the monastery walls for the most famous view of Mount Ararat bathed in golden hour light.
duration_note: Best visited with a private driver or tour; requires 45-minute drive from Yerevan.

name: Sevanavank Medieval Walk
description: Trek up the steep stone steps to the Sevanavank monastery, a dramatic dark-stone structure contrasting against the deep blue water of Lake Sevan. You will study the intricate khachkars (cross-stones) and enjoy panoramic views of the entire alpine basin.
duration_note: Very windy; the path is uneven, wear sturdy shoes.

name: High-Altitude Sailing Session
description: Take to the waters of one of the world's largest high-altitude lakes on a local sailboat. You will experience the brisk mountain winds and the sheer scale of the landscape from the center of the lake, far from the tourist-heavy shores.
duration_note: Only available in summer months (June-August).

name: Ishkhan Trout Feast
description: Sit down at a rustic lakeside tavern to enjoy the famed Sevan 'Ishkhan' (Prince) trout. You will have it served fresh, grilled over wood coals with local wild herbs and a side of traditional Armenian potato salad, overlooking the expanse of the lake.

name: Parz Lake Forest Hike
description: Trek through the dense, verdant woodlands surrounding Parz Lake, a small, emerald-green reservoir hidden deep in the forest. You will breathe in the crisp, pine-scented air while traversing trails that feel like they belong in a fairytale.
duration_note: Trails can be muddy; wear waterproof boots.

name: Haghartsin Monastery Cloister Tour
description: Visit the 13th-century Haghartsin Monastery, tucked away in a remote forest valley. You will admire the refined stone carvings and the massive, vaulted refectory, which is a masterpiece of medieval Armenian secular architecture.
duration_note: Accessible by road; bring a jacket as the forest valley is cool.

name: Areni Cave Archaeology & Wine Tasting
description: Explore the Areni-1 cave, home to the world's oldest known winery, dating back 6,100 years. You will view the ancient fermentation vats before sampling modern, robust red wines crafted from the local Areni grape at a nearby family-run estate.
duration_note: Guided tours of the cave require advance scheduling.

name: Wings of Tatev Aerial Traverse
description: Experience an adrenaline-filled journey on the world's longest non-stop reversible cable car. You will glide over the breathtaking Vorotan Gorge, witnessing the dramatic cliffs from a bird's-eye view, ending at the remote 9th-century Tatev Monastery.
duration_note: Book tickets online to skip the long queues.

name: Jermuk Thermal Spring Soaking
description: Spend an afternoon soaking in the natural mineral-rich thermal baths of the mountain resort town, Jermuk. You will relax in hot waters revered for their therapeutic qualities, surrounded by the towering peaks of the Syunik range.
duration_note: Public and private baths available; bring your own toiletries.

name: Cascade Complex Art Walk
description: Climb the massive 'Cascade' staircase, an open-air art museum that connects the city center to the Monument neighborhood. You will walk past incredible contemporary sculptures by Botero and others, reaching the top for an epic sunset view of the entire city and Mount Ararat.
duration_note: The indoor gallery levels sometimes require a small entry fee.

name: Dinner at Lavash Restaurant
description: Enjoy a refined, contemporary take on traditional Armenian cuisine at this bustling spot on Tumanyan Street. You will feast on 'khashlama' (stewed meat) and fresh local vegetables, served with freshly baked bread pulled directly from the clay tonir ovens in the kitchen.
duration_note: Reservations are required for prime dinner slots.

name: Garni Temple Sunset Tour
description: Stand before the 1st-century Garni Temple, the only standing Greco-Roman colonnade in the entire former Soviet Union. You will explore the ancient bathhouse ruins with their original mosaics and peer down into the dramatic, hexagonal basalt columns of the Garni Gorge.
duration_note: A 45-minute drive from central Yerevan.

name: Geghard Monastery Echo Chamber Discovery
description: Wander through the UNESCO-listed Geghard Monastery, partially carved directly into the solid rock face of the mountain. You will stand in the main chamber to experience the haunting, multi-layered acoustics that have been used for centuries for spiritual choral performances.
duration_note: Modest dress is required; local vendors outside sell sweet Gata.

name: Vernissage Weekend Craft Market
description: Get lost in the sprawling weekend outdoor bazaar, Vernissage, located near Republic Square. You will browse through everything from Soviet-era antiques and hand-knotted carpets to contemporary silver jewelry and hand-carved obsidian chess sets.
duration_note: Best visited on Saturday and Sunday mornings.

name: Live Blues at Beatles Pub
description: Experience an eccentric slice of Yerevan nightlife at this Beatles-themed basement bar decorated with eclectic memorabilia. You will drink local beer and listen to live blues and rock bands playing for a friendly, diverse crowd of locals and travelers.
duration_note: Intimate venue; gets crowded quickly after 10 PM.

name: Hrazdan River Valley Cycling
description: Rent a mountain bike to explore the rugged trails winding through the Hrazdan River canyon. You will ride underneath the iconic Great Bridge and past forgotten industrial landscapes, offering a gritty, off-the-beaten-path perspective of Yerevan’s urban sprawl.
duration_note: Trails are unpaved; helmets are required.

name: Noratus Khachkar Field Expedition
description: Visit the largest collection of medieval khachkars in the world at the Noratus cemetery. You will walk among hundreds of intricately carved stone steles, each unique, reflecting the deep Christian heritage and artistic legacy of the region.
duration_note: Self-guided walk; open all day.

name: Mountain Meadow Birdwatching
description: Explore the diverse ecosystem of Sevan National Park, which serves as a vital stopover for migratory birds. You will bring binoculars to spot rare species amidst the high-altitude marshes and meadows that ring the northern shore of the lake.
duration_note: Best in spring and autumn migrations; bring waterproof gear.

name: Old Town Artisan Crafts Workshop
description: Spend time on Sharambeyan Street, an area preserved in the style of 19th-century Dilijan architecture. You will engage with master potters and woodworkers, trying your hand at crafting local Armenian souvenirs in a historical, cobblestoned setting.
duration_note: Workshops usually require pre-arrangement with local artisans.

name: Goshavank Medieval Manuscript Hike
description: Take a challenging forest hike to Goshavank, a monastery complex where many of Armenia’s oldest manuscripts were meticulously hand-copied. You will traverse forest paths and river crossings to reach the remote site, standing before the famous 'lacework' stone cross.
duration_note: Requires good hiking boots and basic map-reading skills.

name: Forest-side Pub Social
description: Relax at a local Dilijan brewpub that captures the town's slow-paced, mountain vibe. You will sample craft beers infused with local herbs like tarragon, sitting on a deck overlooking the forested hills as the evening mist rolls into the valley.

name: Zorats Karer Observatory Tour
description: Visit the mysterious Zorats Karer (often called the Armenian Stonehenge), a collection of hundreds of prehistoric standing stones. You will explore the site and learn about the astronomical theories suggesting it served as a prehistoric solar observatory thousands of years ago.
duration_note: Exposed site; prepare for strong winds and changing weather.

name: Mountain Biking the Syunik Passes
description: Challenge yourself on high-altitude mountain bike trails that wind through the dramatic, rugged canyons of the Syunik province. You will ride past ancient roadside caravanserai ruins, experiencing the raw, untamed beauty of the Armenian highlands.
duration_note: Requires advanced physical fitness and professional guide.

name: Farm-to-Table Lunch at Areni
description: Enjoy an authentic rural lunch at a family-run vineyard in the heart of the wine region. You will feast on organic, locally sourced produce, fresh cheeses, and grilled meats, all paired with estate-bottled Areni Noir wines.
duration_note: Advance reservation recommended for vineyard dining.

name: National History Museum Deep-Dive
description: Spend a rainy afternoon in the National History Museum of Armenia on Republic Square. You will explore thousands of years of history, including Bronze Age artifacts, Urartian cuneiform tablets, and ornate medieval weaponry that defined the region.
duration_note: Check museum hours before heading out; closed on Mondays.

name: Matenadaran Manuscript Library
description: Visit the Matenadaran, one of the world's largest repositories of ancient manuscripts. You will view beautifully illuminated medieval texts, centuries-old scientific scrolls, and early printed books that protected Armenian culture during centuries of occupation.
duration_note: Photography is restricted inside the manuscript halls.

name: Outdoor Chess Games in the Park
description: Wander through the small park near the Opera House to witness locals playing high-stakes, rapid-fire chess games. You will watch older masters and young students test their strategies in a city where chess is practically a national sport.
duration_note: A great spot for candid photography and people-watching.

name: Sevan Beach Leisure Day
description: Spend a full day relaxing on the sandy beaches of Lake Sevan. You will rent a sunbed, go for a refreshing swim in the alpine water, and enjoy a picnic of local fresh fruit and snacks while soaking in the high-altitude sun.
duration_note: Only suitable for summer months; water is cold even in peak heat.

name: Sevan Peninsula Cycling Path
description: Cycle the flat, coastal road that circles the Sevan Peninsula. You will ride alongside the water, stopping at roadside fish markets and viewpoint benches to take in the vastness of the lake and the distant mountains.
duration_note: Bikes available for rent at most peninsula cafes.

name: Jukhtak Vank Monastery Forest Walk
description: Trek through the gentle, shaded woodland trails leading to the twin churches of Jukhtak Vank. You will enjoy the serenity of the forest and the quiet, partially ruined stone architecture that feels reclaimed by the encroaching nature.
duration_note: Easy trek; suitable for beginners.

name: Deer Park Botanical Stroll
description: Visit the local forest park area where you can observe wild deer roaming through the designated protected enclosures. You will walk along well-maintained paths that showcase the diverse flora and biodiversity of the Tavush province.

name: Great Hermitage of Tatev Hike
description: Descend from the main Tatev Monastery complex down into the Vorotan canyon on a steep, rugged hiking trail. You will explore the ancient, abandoned 'Great Hermitage' of Tatev, a hidden religious site nestled deep in the lush, canyon floor.
duration_note: Very strenuous; not recommended if you have knee problems.

name: Noravank Gorge Photography Trek
description: Drive into the deep, rust-colored Noravank gorge to reach the Noravank monastery complex, famous for its intricate, ornate red-stone carvings. You will climb the narrow, external stone stairs of the church for a spectacular photo of the surrounding jagged canyon.
duration_note: A must-do for sunset; the red rock glows brilliantly.

name: Local Syunik Mountain Cheese Tasting
description: Taste the distinct, sharp, and salty local cheeses produced by semi-nomadic farmers in the high Syunik highlands. You will visit a local creamery or farm to learn about the process of aging cheese in clay jars buried in the earth.
duration_note: Limited availability; look for local farm producers.

name: Jermuk Waterfall Canyon Trek
description: Hike through the gorge leading to the Jermuk waterfall, often called the 'Mermaid's Hair'. You will see the dramatic cascading water, which falls into the Arpa river, and explore the rugged surrounding volcanic rock formations.
duration_note: Can be slippery near the falls; wear appropriate footwear.

name: Erebuni Fortress Historical Walk
description: Explore the ruins of the Erebuni Fortress, the site where the city of Yerevan was founded in 782 BC. You will walk through the ancient, rebuilt ramparts and explore the onsite museum containing artifacts from the Urartian civilization.
duration_note: A bit removed from city center; short taxi ride required.

name: Street Food Crawl at Tashir Mall
description: Explore the vibrant basement food level of Tashir Mall to taste authentic, affordable 'Lahmajo' (Armenian pizza) and 'Borek' (cheese pies). You will navigate the bustling stalls, eating like a local, with fresh juices and pastries available at every turn.

name: Rooftop Drinks at Popock
description: Enjoy an evening cocktail at one of the stylish rooftop bars in central Yerevan. You will look out over the illuminated Republic Square and the Opera house, sipping on unique drinks crafted with locally foraged Armenian herbs.
duration_note: Rooftop season is May to September.

name: Parajanov Museum Experience
description: Visit this charming, eccentric house-museum dedicated to the famous Soviet-Armenian filmmaker and artist Sergei Parajanov. You will marvel at his surreal, intricate collages and movie props, gaining an insight into his unique, visionary mind.
duration_note: A must-see; one of the most unique museums in the Caucasus.

name: Sevan Peninsula Fish Market Walk
description: Explore the vibrant stalls of the fish market on the Sevan shoreline. You will see fresh, local crayfish and trout on display and try local delicacies like stuffed peppers or simple fish kebabs, fresh off the grill.
duration_note: Bring cash as many vendors do not accept cards.

name: Dilijan Local Forest Tea Ceremony
description: Join a traditional tea ceremony using locally foraged mountain herbs like thyme, mint, and rosehip. You will sit in a cozy wooden lodge overlooking the forest, learning about the medicinal traditions passed down through generations of mountain people.
duration_note: Best enjoyed in the afternoon after a long hike.

name: Shaki Waterfall Valley Trek
description: Hike to the massive Shaki Waterfall, which thunders over basalt cliffs into a lush green valley. You will spend the morning walking along the river, taking in the dramatic geology of the Syunik highlands and the refreshing mountain air.
duration_note: A relatively easy walk from the main road; good for families.
